title: Websocket error
description: Carried inside a server message of type "error". Mirrors the REST surface's RFC 7807 bodies in spirit — a stable machine-readable `code` plus prose a client may surface — but stays flat, because a websocket frame has no status line to carry it.

code.description: Stable identifier. Clients branch on this, never on `message`.

message.description: Human-readable prose. Safe to display; never contains credentials or internal detail.

id.description: Echo of the client message's `id`, when the failure is attributable to one. Absent for connection-level failures.
